system.description:
The intensity of the [Pursuit] you deal is increased by +4. A throwing weapon that appears as a bundle of vividly colored cords wrapped around the limbs. When thrown, it hardens into a shape appropriate to the situation, unexpectedly piercing the enemy. Though each individual throw deals little damage, the cumulative effect can deliver damage that cannot be ignored.

Obsidian Arrowhead [Core Material] (500G) + Dirk (640G) + Acidic Poison (Advanced) (360G) + [Magic Catalyst 17] (280G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (880G)
